response.sql: WITH station_stats AS (SELECT o.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_bandwidth_usage, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(telescope_count) FROM station_stats), 0) AS telescope_count_ratio FROM station_stats ORDER BY telescope_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
